svg.aria-label: One evaluation through three hooks: before runs the api, client and invocation hooks in order; the provider is called; after and finallyAfter run in reverse order. On the second pass the provider answers with an error code, so the error stage runs instead of after.
svg.text: ZIO API → client → invocation · Java SDK hooks run inside the provider call
before runs in registration order; after, error and finallyAfter run in reverse, like nested try / finally
